newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Wednesday amid low demand from spinners and dealers said prices were likely to remain stable as spinners await the arrival of the 1997/98 (July-June) crop.
"Spinners are likely to remain selective buyers," dealer Kishin Chand said, adding that they would wait for prices to fall on new arrivals before placing large buying orders.
In the kerb market, MNH-93 was traded between 2,250 ($55.47) to 2,230 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
